notes.title: Hotfix v1.08
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44258165/42703a08a9226ec521e77d31a9e9fac3fc446741.png[/img]
First of all, many thanks to everyone who bought the game and supported us. Thanks also for the constructive comments and reviews. We are here with an update with some minor changes.

You can throw the trash boxes left lying around into the vending machine in front of the shop. And you can get recycling fee. If you have an empty box, the vending machine will become visible.

We have made some changes to the money lost when you fall asleep outside and it is now more balanced.

We slightly increased the disappearance time of the warning messages on the screen.

We got some feedback that the character gets tired fast and needs to sleep quickly, so we decided to increase the amount of time the character stays awake. Now you can stay awake longer.

The effect provided by the Sleepless ability has been increased.

You can now pay less to buy a bouncer.

The thief ability to steal cases has been reduced.

Fixed a few spots where the character could get stuck.

Fixed a bug where when smiler spawns in Backroom, the smiler sound conflicts with another sound.

Fixed a font bug that prevented some languages from reading filenames on the computer.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/Fue8XtE]Discord[/url]

-v1.05
A bug was edited in Backroom that made you go through the wall.

Fixed a bug that caused Mia to go into the wall.

Fixed a font issue in some languages that prevented customer requests from being read in the sticky note.

-v1.06

-I did some work to fix an error caused by the disappearance of the Sticky Note. Probably this bug may have disappeared in new saves.

-Fixed virus save/load problem.

-Fixed new font issues that were detected.

-When entering a key into the operating system, you can move to the next field with the Tab key.
And all entered text is automatically set to uppercase

-v1.07

-A bug that prevented experience from viruses has been fixed.

-Fixed a bug that caused items to be lost when receiving newly arrived shipments.

-Fixed a bug that prevented the seller of robots from refreshing their store.

-Fixed a bug that caused the tutorial to be off-screen on some screen resolutions.

-v1.08

-Fixed an bug with saving sticky notes. This problem no longer occurs on new cases.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479290/Computer_Repair_Shop/
